sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of "Punch Skibidi Toilets" are straightforward yet challenging. As mentioned earlier, your goal is to punch down trees to create a path for your character to run as far as possible. The twist is that you need to time your punches perfectly, as a successful punch will knock down a tree, but a missed punch will leave the tree standing, blocking your path.

The game features a variety of trees, each with its own difficulty level and timing requirements. Some trees will require a quick jab, while others will demand a powerful swing. You'll need to study the trees' behaviors and adjust your strategy accordingly.

As you progress through the levels, the trees will become increasingly challenging to knock down. You'll encounter trees with multiple obstacles, trees that will regenerate if you miss a punch, and even trees that will change their size and timing requirements mid-level. The game requires a combination of quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and a bit of luck.

To succeed, you'll need to develop a consistent timing and a deep understanding of the game's mechanics. This is where the game's addictive nature comes in – you'll want to keep playing to improve your skills and beat your high scores.
